title: Jovial Mustardy Kenyan Beef Lasagna
description: A midnight-craving Kenyan dish featuring lasagna sheets and a mustardy flavor, diabetic-friendly and cooked to perfection in a Dutch oven. This shattering dish is sure to satisfy any craving.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the lasagna sheets according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the onion until softened.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Stir in the mustard and tomato sauce, bringing the mixture to a simmer.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked lasagna sheets, meat sauce, and mozzarella cheese.

In a greased Dutch oven, create a thin layer of the meat sauce, followed by a layer of lasagna sheets, and then a layer of cheese, repeating this process until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Cover the Dutch oven with a lid and bake for 30 minutes, then remove the lid and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the lasagna from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
